verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֣מּוּ כָל־ הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲב֖וֹר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן פ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- tam·mū ḵāl hag·gō·w la·‘ă·ḇō·wr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dēn p̄ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan the LORD said to Joshua . . .
verses.literalPt: SUCEDEU que, acabando todo o povo de passar o Jordão, falou o SENHOR a Josué, dizendo:

verses.original: קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־ הָעָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֲנָשִׁ֑ים אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū lā·ḵem min- hā·‘ām šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ’ă·nā·šîm ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ miš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: Choose twelve . . . . . . men from among the people one . . . . . . from each tribe
verses.literalPt: Tomai do povo doze homens, de cada tribo um homem;

verses.original: וְצַוּ֣וּ אוֹתָם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ שְׂאֽוּ־ לָכֶ֨ם מִזֶּ֜ה מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מִמַּצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים הָכִ֖ין שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֑ים וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם בַּמָּל֕וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ תָּלִ֥ינוּ ב֖וֹ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣaw·wū ’ō·w·ṯām lê·mōr śə·’ū- lā·ḵem miz·zeh mit·tō·wḵ hay·yar·dên mim·maṣ·ṣaḇ raḡ·lê hak·kō·hă·nîm hā·ḵîn šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh ’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tem ’ō·w·ṯām ‘im·mā·ḵem wə·hin·naḥ·tem ’ō·w·ṯām bam·mā·lō·wn ’ă·šer- tā·lî·nū ḇōw hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: and command them - Take up for yourselves twelve . . . stones from the middle of the Jordan . . . . . . where the priests were standing carry them with you and set them down in the place where you spend the night
verses.literalPt: E mandai-lhes, dizendo: Tirai daqui, do meio do Jordão, do lugar onde estavam firmes os pés dos sacerdotes, doze pedras; e levai-as convosco à outra margem e depositai-as no alojamento em que haveis de passar esta noite.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אֶל־ שְׁנֵ֤ים הֶֽעָשָׂר֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- šə·nêm he·‘ā·śār ’îš ’ă·šer hê·ḵîn mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ miš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: So Joshua . . . summoned the twelve . . . men he had appointed from the Israelites . . . one . . . . . . . . . from each tribe
verses.literalPt: Chamou, pois, Josué os doze homens, que escolhera dos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo um homem;

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עִ֠בְרוּ לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהָרִ֨ימוּ לָכֶ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶ֤בֶן אַחַת֙ עַל־ שִׁכְמ֔וֹ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ‘iḇ·rū lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’el- tō·wḵ hay·yar·dên wə·hā·rî·mū lā·ḵem ’îš ’e·ḇen ’a·ḥaṯ ‘al- šiḵ·mōw lə·mis·par šiḇ·ṭê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: and said to them . . . Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder according to the number of the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Josué: Passai adiante da arca do SENHOR vosso Deus, ao meio do Jordão; e cada um levante uma pedra sobre o ombro, segundo o número das tribos dos filhos de Israel;

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תִּֽהְיֶ֛ה זֹ֥את א֖וֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֛ה הָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tih·yeh zōṯ ’ō·wṯ bə·qir·bə·ḵem kî- yiš·’ā·lūn bə·nê·ḵem mā·ḥār lê·mōr māh hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: to serve as a sign among you In the future . . . when your children ask What do these stones mean to you
verses.literalPt: Para que isto seja por sinal entre vós; e quando vossos filhos no futuro perguntarem, dizendo: Que significam estas pedras?

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִכְרְת֜וּ מֵימֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִפְּנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּעָבְרוֹ֙ בַּיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִכְרְת֖וּ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֠הָיוּ הָאֲבָנִ֨ים הָאֵ֧לֶּה לְזִכָּר֛וֹן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem lā·hem ’ă·šer niḵ·rə·ṯū mê·mê hay·yar·dên mip·pə·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh bə·‘ā·ḇə·rōw bay·yar·dên niḵ·rə·ṯū mê hay·yar·dên wə·hā·yū hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh lə·zik·kā·rō·wn liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: you are to tell them The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD When it crossed the Jordan the waters were cut off Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites . . . forever
verses.literalPt: Então lhes direis que as águas do Jordão se separaram diante da arca da aliança do SENHOR; passando ela pelo Jordão, separaram-se as águas do Jordão; assim estas pedras serão para sempre por memorial aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֣ן בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַיִּשְׂא֡וּ שְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אֲבָנִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲבִר֤וּם עִמָּם֙ אֶל־ הַמָּל֔וֹן וַיַּנִּח֖וּם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·nê- yiś·rå̄·ʾēl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yiś·’ū šə·tê- ‘eś·rêh ’ă·ḇā·nîm mit·tō·wḵ hay·yar·dên ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lə·mis·par šiḇ·ṭê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rūm ‘im·mām ’el- ham·mā·lō·wn way·yan·ni·ḥūm šām
verses.literal: Thus the Israelites . . . did . . . as Joshua had commanded them They took up twelve . . . stones from the middle of the Jordan one for each tribe of Israel just as the LORD had told Joshua and they carried them to the camp where they set them down . . .
verses.literalPt: Fizeram, pois, os filhos de Israel assim como Josué tinha ordenado, e levantaram doze pedras do meio do Jordão como o SENHOR dissera a Josué, segundo o número das tribos dos filhos de Israel; e levaram-nas consigo ao alojamento, e as depositaram ali. 9 Levantou Josué também doze pedras no meio do Jordão, no lugar onde estiveram parados os pés dos sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança; e ali estão até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֗ים הֵקִ֣ים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תַּ֗חַת מַצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ’ă·ḇā·nîm hê·qîm yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yar·dên ta·ḥaṯ maṣ·ṣaḇ raḡ·lê hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn hab·bə·rîṯ way·yih·yū šām ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Joshua also set up twelve . . . stones in the middle of the Jordan in the place where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant stood . . . And the stones are there to this day
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָאָר֗וֹן עֹמְדִים֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ עַ֣ד תֹּ֣ם כָּֽל־ הַ֠דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְמַהֲר֥וּ הָעָ֖ם וַֽיַּעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê hā·’ā·rō·wn ‘ō·mə·ḏîm bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yar·dên ‘aḏ tōm kāl- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·ma·hă·rū hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū
verses.literal: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until the people had completed everything . . . the LORD had commanded Joshua to tell them just as Moses had directed Joshua The people hurried across
verses.literalPt: Pararam, pois, os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca, no meio do Jordão, em pé, até que se cumpriu tudo quanto o SENHOR mandara Josué dizer ao povo, conforme a tudo quanto Moisés tinha ordenado a Josué; e apressou-se o povo, e passou.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֥ם כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לַֽעֲב֑וֹר וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָ֛ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- tam kāl- hā·‘ām la·‘ă·ḇō·wr way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’ă·rō·wn- Yah·weh wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm lip̄·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: and after everyone . . . had finished crossing the priests with the ark of the LORD crossed in the sight of the people
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, assim que todo o povo acabou de passar, então passou a arca do SENHOR, e os sacerdotes, à vista do povo.

verses.original: וַ֠יַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי־ רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּבְנֵי־ גָ֜ד וַחֲצִ֨י שֵׁ֤בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ חֲמֻשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū bə·nê- rə·’ū·ḇên ū·ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ wa·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh ḥă·mu·šîm lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ’ă·lê·hem mō·šeh
verses.literal: The Reubenites . . . the Gadites . . . and the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh crossed over before the Israelites . . . armed for battle as Moses had instructed them . . .
verses.literalPt: E passaram os filhos de Rúben, e os filhos de Gade, e a meia tribo de Manassés, armados na frente dos filhos de Israel, como Moisés lhes tinha falado;

verses.original: כְּאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א עָבְר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶ֖ל עַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ ḥă·lū·ṣê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ‘ā·ḇə·rū lip̄·nê Yah·weh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ’el ‘ar·ḇō·wṯ yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: About 40,000 . . . troops armed . . . for battle crossed over before the LORD into the plains of Jericho
verses.literalPt: Uns quarenta mil homens de guerra, armados, passaram diante do SENHOR para batalha, às campinas de Jericó.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא גִּדַּ֤ל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽרְא֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָרְא֥וּ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū gid·dal Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bə·‘ê·nê kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·yir·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer yā·rə·’ū ’eṯ- mō·šeh kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yāw
verses.literal: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel and they revered him all the days of his life just as they had revered Moses
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia o SENHOR engrandeceu a Josué diante dos olhos de todo o Israel; e temeram-no, como haviam temido a Moisés, todos os dias da sua vida.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Joshua . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou, pois, o SENHOR a Josué, dizendo:

verses.original: צַוֵּה֙ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְיַעֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw·wêh ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ wə·ya·‘ă·lū min- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Dá ordem aos sacerdotes, que levam a arca do testemunho, que subam do Jordão.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm lê·mōr ‘ă·lū min- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: So Joshua commanded the priests . . . Come up from the Jordan
verses.literalPt: E deu Josué ordem aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Subi do Jordão.

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִי בַּעֲלוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִתְּק֗וּ כַּפּוֹת֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֶ֖ל הֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֤בוּ מֵֽי־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לִמְקוֹמָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כִתְמוֹל־ שִׁלְשׁ֖וֹם עַל־ כָּל־ גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·ʿă·lōṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh mit·tō·wḵ hay·yar·dên nit·tə·qū kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lê hak·kō·hă·nîm ’el he·ḥā·rā·ḇāh way·yā·šu·ḇū mê- hay·yar·dên lim·qō·w·mām way·yê·lə·ḵū ḵiṯ·mō·wl- šil·šō·wm ‘al- kāl- gə·ḏō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: When the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up out of the Jordan and their feet . . . touched the dry land the waters of the Jordan returned to their course and overflowed all the banks as before . . .
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, como os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança do SENHOR, subiram do meio do Jordão, e as plantas dos pés dos sacerdotes se puseram em seco, as águas do Jordão se tornaram ao seu lugar, e corriam, como antes, sobre todas as suas ribanceiras.

verses.original: וְהָעָ֗ם עָלוּ֙ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל בִּקְצֵ֖ה מִזְרַ֥ח יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ām ‘ā·lū min- hay·yar·dên be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn way·ya·ḥă·nū bag·gil·gāl biq·ṣêh miz·raḥ yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho
verses.literalPt: Subiu, pois, o povo, do Jordão no dia dez do mês primeiro; e alojaram-se em Gilgal, do lado oriental de Jericó.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הֵקִ֥ים יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·têm ‘eś·rêh hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer lā·qə·ḥū min- hay·yar·dên hê·qîm yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: And there at Gilgal Joshua set up the twelve . . . stones they had taken from the Jordan
verses.literalPt: E as doze pedras, que tinham tomado do Jordão, levantou-as Josué em Gilgal.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֖ה הָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’ă·šer yiš·’ā·lūn bə·nê·ḵem mā·ḥār ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lê·mōr māh hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Then Joshua said to the Israelites . . . . . . In the future when your children ask their fathers . . . What is the meaning of these stones
verses.literalPt: E falou aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Quando no futuro vossos filhos perguntarem a seus pais, dizendo: Que significam estas pedras?

verses.original: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה֙ עָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·tem ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem lê·mōr bay·yab·bā·šāh ‘ā·ḇar yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên haz·zeh
verses.literal: you are to tell them . . . Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground
verses.literalPt: Fareis saber a vossos filhos, dizendo: Israel passou em seco este Jordão.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִישׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֜ם אֶת־ מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵיכֶ֖ם עַֽד־ עָבְרְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֧ם לְיַם־ ס֛וּף אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִ֥ישׁ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ עַד־ עָבְרֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- hō·w·ḇîš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’eṯ- mê hay·yar·dên mip·pə·nê·ḵem ‘aḏ- ‘ā·ḇə·rə·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lə·yam- sūp̄ ’ă·šer- hō·w·ḇîš mip·pā·nê·nū ‘aḏ- ‘ā·ḇə·rê·nū
verses.literal: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over just as He . . . did to the Red Sea which He dried up before us until we had crossed over
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR vosso Deus fez secar as águas do Jordão diante de vós, até que passásseis, como o SENHOR vosso Deus fez ao Mar Vermelho que fez secar perante nós, até que passássemos.

verses.original: לְ֠מַעַן דַּ֜עַת כָּל־ עַמֵּ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־ יַ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חֲזָקָ֖ה הִ֑יא לְמַ֧עַן יְרָאתֶ֛ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an da·‘aṯ kāl- ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- yaḏ Yah·weh kî ḥă·zā·qāh hî lə·ma·‘an yə·rā·ṯem ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty . . . and so that you may always . . . fear the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Para que todos os povos da terra conheçam a mão do SENHOR, que é forte, para que temais ao SENHOR vosso Deus todos os dias.
